item.title: Multibeam Appoints David J. Lam as Interim CFO After New Funding Agreements
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Multibeam Corporation today announced the appointment of 25-year finance veteran David J. Lam as Interim Chief Financial Officer, further strengthening the company’s executive leadership team as it enters its next phase of growth with up to $205 million in strategic funding and financing.
